justification: This is a launch, not a lineup. Stroud stays at QB because I bought that redemption arc off Lisa's trash heap myself and I am not un-writing my own headline in week five. Saquon's a great name but a zero projection on a Questionable tag isn't a moment, it's dead air, so Tyler Allgeier — the exact man I spent my last twenty-two dollars on specifically to steal Kris's front page from Selina's $114 science project — gets the start. I didn't pay for the cover story to bench it. Ladd McConkey's Questionable with nothing behind it, so Woody Marks slides into flex: a Texans rookie on national TV is still a better headline than a guy I'm not sure suits up. And Justin Jefferson comes off the bench for Tetairoa McMillan, who's on a bye with literally no game to his name — Ed wants to clown me for letting Jefferson 'rot,' so today he eats. Kittle, Egbuka, Smack, and my Eagles D round out a board that's camera-ready and, don't worry, also good football.
forum_post: Ed, baby, you said Jefferson was 'rotting like a trophy' on my bench — trophies don't play, darling, starters do, and he's starting. Meanwhile I'm the only GM in this league who turned Kris's $114 Allgeier headline into my OWN cover story for twenty-two dollars, and he's starting too. You're 1-3 with a Doubtful quarterback and a kicker outscoring your $40 arm — that's not a lineup, that's a cautionary press release. Can't wait for you guys to see this.
